column1: # Genealogies simulated by the R phylopomp fork atpabuser/phylopomp 0.19.5.4 with the models and parameters of
# scripts/mgp_filter_crossvalidate.R, with R's filter logmeanexp and SE (Np = 5000, 40 runs) and, for LBDP, lbdp_exact.
# bdss_pomp exists only in that fork. The SI2R row is from upstream kingaa/phylopomp 0.19.8.1, whose si2rs_pomp has the
# fix of commit 4c5f673; the fork's si2rs_pomp gives log-likelihoods up to 52 units higher (docs/note_r_si2r_pomp.md).
# Upstream's SI2R filter deletes a sampled host, while PhyloPOMP.SI2R sends it to R; with that change made in R
# (docs/fork_si2r_sample_to_R.patch) the value for this 3-sample tree is -4.9458 ± 0.0419 instead of -4.9134.
# columns: model, tree, newick, time, R_est, R_se, exact
